title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP06b2 — weaken-policy coverage for D18 domain authorities
goal: Complete Plan 06 P4.3 with D25: D18 blocking findings become policy-weakening obligations covered by weaken-policy, and the authority gates recompute that coverage with the base verifier for the explicit pull request head, never from the checkout.
acceptanceCriteria: The D18 comparison has a Git object mode, and the protected change verifier and the authorization generator treat blocking findings as policy-weakening obligations with schema domain-authority:<id> and the blocking pointers.

Validate, Architecture and Specialized runs with an explicit -HeadRef accept blocking findings only when the base verifier report bound to base, merge base, head and the base registry and schema hashes covers each with exactly one consumed weaken-policy authorization; the checkout must match the explicit head, and without it the findings fail closed.
The workflow passes the pull request head SHA to those runs, and the D18 gate trust contracts describe the coverage.
The pull request consumes both CP06b2-auth authorizations under the CP06b1 base, and all 13 required checks pass.
